title: Resveratrol improves idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis by targeting IKZF3.
authors: Liu, Shuai; Wang, Lixin; Yue, Yinyan; Ma, DongBo; Deng, Xiang; Wang, Yuanfang; Wu, Dongdong; Wang, Yang; Wu, Qiuge
one_liner_zh: 该文研究白藜芦醇通过靶向转录因子IKZF3改善肺纤维化，涉及分子对接但核心为疾病治疗与湿实验验证，非TF-DNA互作机制建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive lung disease with limited treatment options. This study investigates the therapeutic potential of resveratrol, a natural compound, in treating IPF by targeting IKZF3, a transcription factor upregulated in IPF patients. Using bioinformatics analysis of the GSE110147 dataset, we identified IKZF3 as a key molecule in IPF progression. In vitro experiments with bleomycin (BLM)-treated A549 cells showed that IKZF3 overexpression exacerbated cell death and fibrosis, while its silencing reversed these effects. Resveratrol treatment significantly improved cell viability, reduced fibrosis markers, and inhibited IKZF3's transcriptional regulation of IL-33, which in turn decreased ILC-2 activation. Molecular docking revealed a strong binding affinity between resveratrol and IKZF3. In vivo validation using a BLM-induced IPF mouse model demonstrated that resveratrol reduced lung fibrosis and downregulated fibrosis-related markers. Our findings suggest that targeting IKZF3 with resveratrol may offer a novel therapeutic strategy for IPF, highlighting the potential of this combination to improve disease outcomes.
abstract_zh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种进行性肺部疾病，治疗选择有限。本研究探讨了天然化合物白藜芦醇通过靶向IKZF3（一种在IPF患者中上调的转录因子）治疗IPF的潜力。通过对GSE110147数据集的生物信息学分析，我们确定IKZF3是IPF进展中的关键分子。使用博来霉素（BLM）处理的A549细胞进行的体外实验表明，IKZF3过表达加剧了细胞死亡和纤维化，而其沉默则逆转了这些效应。白藜芦醇治疗显著改善了细胞活力，减少了纤维化标志物，并抑制了IKZF3对IL-33的转录调控，进而降低了ILC-2的激活。分子对接显示白藜芦醇与IKZF3之间具有强结合亲和力。使用BLM诱导的IPF小鼠模型进行的体内验证表明，白藜芦醇减少了肺纤维化并下调了纤维化相关标志物。我们的研究结果表明，用白藜芦醇靶向IKZF3可能为IPF提供一种新的治疗策略，凸显了这种组合改善疾病结局的潜力。
